topic: Club Pilates Unveils Refreshed Studio Design Ahead of 20th Anniversary

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Club Pilates Unveils Refreshed Studio Design Ahead of 20th Anniversary

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Club Pilates is modernizing its studios with updated equipment, lighting and retail areas as it looks to build on its growth. The world’s largest Pilates franchise is modernizing its studios with updated equipment, lighting and retail areas as it looks to build on its growth Club Pilates is rolling out a refreshed studio design, introducing a more modern look and feel as the world’s largest Pilates franchise approaches its 20th anniversary in 2027. The new concept, which debuted at a Club Pilates location in Foothill Ranch, California, in July, includes updated lighting, equipment and finishes, along with redesigned lobby and retail areas. New Club Pilates studios will adopt the design moving forward, while existing franchisees will have the option to upgrade their locations. “As Club Pilates continues to lead and define the boutique Pilates category, this refreshed studio concept reflects the strength and staying power of our brand,” said Club Pilates president Tianna Strateman. “For nearly 20 years, we have set the standard for making Pilates more accessible, approachable and relevant to a broad community of members.” The refresh comes as competition in the Pilates space heats up , with established operators expanding aggressively and newer concepts vying for a share of growing consumer demand.

topic: Midtown Athletic Club Launches FORGE, an Innovative New Strength Training Experience

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Midtown Athletic Club Launches FORGE, an Innovative New Strength Training Experience

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Midtown Athletic Club launched FORGE at its Bannockburn and Palatine locations in Chicago’s suburbs . The sophisticated strength training experience challenges the body through controlled resistance, integrated movement and sustained muscular tension. Bringing the innovation of boutique strength studios into Midtown’s comprehensive wellness environment, FORGE offers members a progressive, low-impact approach to building strength, stability and control through specialized XFormer equipment and intentional programming. Unlike many boutique strength studios that require separate memberships or individual class purchases, FORGE gives members access to a premium, specialized strength experience as part of the broader Midtown membership. This integrated approach allows members to explore innovative training alongside Midtown’s existing fitness, recovery and social offerings, supporting a more connected approach to overall well-being. Rooted in the philosophy that strength is built through precision rather than intensity alone, FORGE combines unique spring resistance, a moving carriage and carefully designed movements to create continuous muscular engagement. Each exercise emphasizes control, stability and sustained tension, challenging members to develop strength through deliberate movement while minimizing impact.

topic: New wellness third places are taking shape

facts.label: Story
facts.value: New wellness third places are taking shape

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Listening bars, tea houses, book clubs, chess clubs, and creative spaces are emerging as alternatives to gyms, studios, and longevity clinics. These concepts tap into a different side of wellness . Instead of tracking performance or optimizing health, they give people a place to connect, share interests, and spend time together offline. The idea of a third place — somewhere beyond home and work — isn’t new. But as people look for more meaningful ways to spend time and build community, these spaces are taking on renewed relevance. For wellness operators, the opportunity is to create experiences people return to for more than a service or product. The draw is the community itself.
